Importance of bond stats! 

They add directly into the stats of the equipped pets!!!!! 

Now this is why having UR bonds +7 is important!!!

Should you still pull for exr if you can’t make it +13? 

You should minimally try to pull teddy till +4 (if possible) for the bonds to activate on your +7 bone fish and seruf!
***UR PETS AND EXR PETS LIMITED BANNER DO NOT SHARE PITY COUNT***

Bonds will **AUTOMATICALLY** append to your pet stats

*Image Example is EXR Master Death Teddy with Max Bonds*

Optimal PVP Set up now is 
- Viking (Self Explanatory)
- Bubble Fish (Self Explanatory)
- Dyle (Self Explanatory)
- Master Death Teddy (Self Explanatory)
- Gatekeeper (Shieldsssss)
- Bone Fish (For Stun) (Even for Warriors, having Bonefish means you have 2 chances of stunning your opponent, hence you should still be using Bonefish)
- Eliza (Until Cornian Release)

Optimal PVE Set up now is 
- Viking (Self Explanatory)
- Bubble Fish (Self Explanatory)
- Master Death Teddy (Self Explanatory)
- Gatekeeper (Shieldsssss)
- Bone Fish (For Stun) (Even for Warriors, having Bonefish means you have 2 chances of stunning your opponent, hence you should still be using Bonefish)
- Dyle (If you are struggling to survive)
- Eliza > Flying Fish > Skull Monster (Until Cornian Release, Eliza and Flying Fish are still used in niche situations i.e. Hex/Rage Block Situations. Will probably replace Dyle in those situations)

***Generic Guideline for EXR*** 
- Pull EXR + 4 if you can unlock all bonds, otherwise don't pull 
- Pull till +6 if you can afford for Illustration (Affording is based off whether you have enough to enhance +6 or 13 for the next EXR you will be pulling for) 
- All in if essential EXR
PLEASE DO NOT PULL JUST 1 COPY, BEING UNABLE TO REPLACE ANYTHING JUST MEANS A PROGRESSION GATEKEEP

+4 = 3 exr copies
+6 = 4 EXR copies
